description: This Java class 'PermissionRecorder' provides services for managing and recording permissions related to Content entities within the OFBiz framework. It includes methods for configuring permission checks, recording results, and generating HTML reports for permissions testing.

classes.name: PermissionRecorder
classes.description: Main class providing permission checking and recording functionalities. Handles the internal state of permission checks, content data, and reporting mechanisms.

methods.name: getCheckMode
methods.description: Returns the current permission check mode.

methods.name: setCheckMode
methods.description: Sets the permission check mode.

methods.name: isOn
methods.description: Indicates whether the permission recorder is active based on configuration.

methods.name: setOn
methods.description: Enables or disables the permission recorder.

methods.name: getUserLogin
methods.description: Retrieves the current user login information.

methods.name: setUserLogin
methods.description: Sets the user login context for permission checks.

methods.name: getEntityPermCheckResult
methods.description: Returns the result of the entity permission check.

methods.name: setEntityPermCheckResult
methods.description: Sets the outcome of the entity permission check.

methods.name: getContentPurposeOperations
methods.description: Retrieves the content purpose operations array.

methods.name: setContentPurposeOperations
methods.description: Sets the content purpose operations list.

methods.name: getPrivilegeEnumId
methods.description: Gets the privilege enumeration ID.

methods.name: setPrivilegeEnumId
methods.description: Sets the privilege enumeration ID.

methods.name: getStatusTargets
methods.description: Retrieves target status array.

methods.name: setStatusTargets
methods.description: Sets target status list.

methods.name: getTargetOperations
methods.description: Retrieves target operations array.

methods.name: setTargetOperations
methods.description: Sets target operations list.

methods.name: setCurrentContentId
methods.description: Sets the current content ID; initializes a new content map if changed.

methods.name: getCurrentContentId
methods.description: Returns the current content ID.

methods.name: setRoles
methods.description: Associates roles with the current content context.

methods.name: setPurposes
methods.description: Associates purposes with the current content context.

methods.name: startMatchGroup
methods.description: Begins a new permission match group for a content item with specified parameters.

methods.name: record
methods.description: Records a point-in-time result of a permission check for a specific content operation.

methods.name: toHtml
methods.description: Generates an HTML report summarizing the permission check results, including pass/fail status.

methods.name: renderCurrentContentMapHtml
methods.description: Renders HTML rows for a specific content map.

methods.name: renderResultRowHtml
methods.description: Renders HTML for individual permission check result rows.
